prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- sign_in: 75.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In After Pet Customization: Move account sign-in to take place after pet adoption choice and certificate creation so users build connection before creating an account. (why: Funnel drop-off occurs early and 8 support tickets report confusion around signing in with the wrong account losing pets.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Controls Guide Screen: Add a dedicated interactive controls guide screen before final launch teaching users how to drag, hide, and interact with desktop pets. (why: 3 support tickets specifically mention confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to the pet after onboarding.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Display Verification Flow: Insert a desktop visibility check sub-flow right after waiting step to confirm pet overlay renders correctly. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show on desktop or app not opening after setup.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Existing Account Notice: Add explicit hint text on sign in advising returning users to sign in with their existing account to restore pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or account reset after signing back in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Tips Carousel: Add a dynamic tips carousel and precise progress ETA on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step in adoption/home phase takes median 89s to 201s, leading to drop-offs.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Clarify Path Choice Headline: Update headline and body on path selection screen to clearly distinguish quick preset adoption vs custom creation. (why: Choose path screen takes median 8s but mean 514s, indicating initial user hesitation.)
6: [home, notification] Background Desktop Notification Toggle: Enable desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes. (why: Mean waiting time before home screen is high (2336s), causing users to lose track of setup.)
7: [finish, layout] Split Controls Cheatsheet Layout: Change home_intro layout to split format containing a desktop controls cheatsheet component. (why: 3 support tickets asked how to control and manage the desktop pet post-onboarding.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in after pet adoption addresses sign_in drop-off and strong support email feedback.
Adding a new controls screen addresses finish step drop-off and 3 support tickets, but requires a new release.
Desktop verification check requires a new flow to fix rendering issues reported in 3 tickets.
Config-only hint text directly addresses 8 support emails regarding lost pet accounts.
Tips carousel mitigates user friction during the long wait time on the home/adoption phase.
Simple copy update to clarify path choice helps reduce high mean time on initial step.
Notification prompt helps re-engage users during the long background waiting period.
Layout modification provides controls clarity at the finish step without building a whole new screen.
